title: Learn RAPP step by step
description: The RAPP production guide as data: 14 steps from discovery call to post-deployment review, the concepts behind them, a glossary and the experimental tools.
start: Each step has do (what to do), get (what you get) and proof (how you know it is done).
Look up a word in api/v1/rapp/glossary.json, or a topic in api/v1/rapp/concepts/<slug>.json.

steps.title: Step 1: Discovery Call
steps.summary: Capture the customer's biggest problems in their own words - this transcript becomes the foundation for everything.

steps.title: Step 2: Audit - Transcript Analysis
steps.summary: Quality Gate #1: Verify we extracted the right problem before building anything.

steps.title: Step 3: Generate MVP "Poke"
steps.summary: Send the customer a lightweight MVP summary to confirm we heard them correctly - BEFORE writing any code.

steps.title: Step 4: Audit - Customer Validation
steps.summary: Quality Gate #2: Customer signs off on MVP scope before any code is written.

steps.title: Step 5: Generate Agent Code
steps.summary: Use the RAPP Agent Generator to create production-ready Python agents from the locked MVP.

steps.title: Step 6: Audit - Code Quality Review
steps.summary: Quality Gate #3: Human review of generated code for logic errors, security issues, and integration problems.

steps.title: Step 7: Deploy Prototype
steps.summary: Get working agents into Azure and M365 Copilot in minutes

steps.title: Step 8: Audit - Demo Review
steps.summary: Quality Gate #4: Customer sees working prototype and provides feedback

steps.title: Step 9: Generate Video Demo
steps.summary: Create polished, shareable demo video for executive presentations and marketing

steps.title: Step 10: Audit - Final Demo Review
steps.summary: Quality Gate #5: Customer confirms video demo is ready to share with executives

steps.title: Step 11: Production Planning
steps.summary: Define security, compliance, rollout strategy, and production requirements

steps.title: Step 12: Audit - Security & Compliance Sign-off
steps.summary: Quality Gate #6: IT/Security/Compliance approve production deployment

steps.title: Step 13: Production Deployment
steps.summary: Move from prototype to production with phased rollout

steps.title: Step 14: Post-Deployment Review
steps.summary: Measure success, gather learnings, plan Phase 2 improvements
